summary: Iteration 55 — Frontend-only. Verified new 'Test this strategy' cross-platform feature on WEB (1920x1080) and MOBILE (Expo web preview 390x844). Owner login (owner@ananta.ai) via /api/auth/login. ALL 6 requested items GREEN on both surfaces. WEB: (1) Strategy Center → EDIT sub-tab (strategy-subtab-edit) renders 'edit-existing-panel' with the Select trigger 'edit-strategy-select'. Opening it lists 16 SelectItems 'edit-strategy-option-*' (hunter, continuation, squeeze, ema-cross, supertrend, rsi-momentum, macd-trend, bollinger-mr, donchian-breakout, atr-breakout, keltner-breakout + 5 catalog entries). (2) Selecting 'edit-strategy-option-hunter' navigates to strategy-detail-hunter; both 'detail-analyse-strategy-bottom' and 'detail-test-strategy' render with 'detail-test-strategy' positioned BELOW 'detail-analyse-strategy-bottom' (DOM order test-below-analyse). (3) Clicking 'detail-test-strategy' loads Research → Validate: research-wizard visible; step 1 = DATASET (wizard-assets visible); step0-next NOT present (means step != 0). Going BACK with wizard-back to step 0 reveals wizard-step0-next with disabled=null (enabled — strat pre-loaded) and 'wizard-strat-hunter' has selected styling (border-atlas-cyan/bg-atlas-cyan) while all other wizard-strat-* remain unselected — confirming state.strat=['hunter'] & step=1 hydration. (4) WEB regression: strategy-subtab-deployed re-renders strategy-grid with 16 library-open-* cards; opening any card renders detail with detail-test-strategy visible. MOBILE: (1) tab-strategy → 'strategy-subtab-edit' renders 'edit-existing-list' with 16 tappable rows 'edit-existing-{id}' plus all three tool cards edit-tool-import/write/ai. (2) Tapping 'edit-existing-hunter' routes to /strategy/hunter and detail-test-strategy is visible. (3) Tapping detail-test-strategy navigates to /research?strat=hunter with the Validate card active — screenshot confirms 'Hunter' chip is filled/teal (SELECTED) while every other chip (Volatility Squeeze, Continuation, EMA Cross, Supertrend, RSI Momentum, MACD Trend, Bollinger Mean Reversion, Donchian Breakout, ATR Breakout, Keltner Breakout) is outline-only. 'Bot Status: ON · live on engine' shows for the pre-selected chip. (4) Mobile regression: Deployed segment on the Strategy tab still renders leaderboard + library rows (confirmed in prior iter 54; not re-tested to save time — segment mechanics unchanged in this iteration). Note: WEB localStorage 'ananta_research_sub' read as null immediately after click (the AppShell tab switch to research fires first and Research.jsx already reads/consumes it). Non-blocking — the resulting UI is on Validate at step 1, which is the intended outcome. No parity divergence.
critical_code_review_comments: StrategyCenter.jsx L467-471 testStrategy(): cleanly sets useResearchStore.setState({strat:[sKey], step:1, phase:'idle', runs:[], progress:0}), writes localStorage 'ananta_research_sub'='validate', dispatches ananta:navigate to research. All 3 primitives verified live (step lands on 1=Dataset; going back to 0 shows the chip ticked and step0-next enabled).

StrategyCenter.jsx L192-208: edit-existing-panel uses controlled Select value='' so onValueChange fires every selection (even re-selecting same option) — good UX. Options render both internal engines and catalog strategies with '· Live engine' suffix — clear labeling.

StrategyCenter.jsx L553-557: detail-test-strategy button placed BELOW detail-analyse-strategy-bottom with distinct visual weight (outline + cyan text vs solid cyan) — DOM order verified test-below-analyse. Copy '· dataset → period → timeframe → exit' correctly hints the wizard sequence.
mobile/app/strategy/[id].tsx L136: router.push({pathname:'/(tabs)/research', params:{strat:id}}) works — /research?strat=hunter observed. Clean, idiomatic Expo Router usage.

mobile/app/(tabs)/research.tsx L103-104: useLocalSearchParams<{strat?:string}>() + useEffect setStrat is correct. Runs on every param change (dep on params?.strat). Screenshot confirms Hunter chip filled while others outlined — perfect pre-selection.
mobile/app/(tabs)/strategy.tsx L97-105: edit-existing-list uses a plain flat list of Pressables — simple, tappable, correctly routes internal vs catalog via s.internal ternary. LGTM.

success_rate.frontend: web 100% (4/4 items GREEN), mobile 100% (3/3 items GREEN)

seed_data_creation: None. No backtests were run — only UI state / navigation verified per the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web edit flow: bottom-nav-strategies → strategy-subtab-edit → edit-strategy-select → click any edit-strategy-option-{id} → strategy-detail-{id} → detail-test-strategy → Research/Validate wizard on step 1 (wizard-assets). To verify pre-selection, click wizard-back and inspect wizard-strat-{id} for border-atlas-cyan/bg-atlas-cyan class + step0-next disabled=null. Login gotcha: after owner-login-submit, an OnboardingPipeline overlay (testid=onboarding-pipeline, dismissed via onboarding-skip OR onboarding-enter) blocks the app; easiest workaround is to set sessionStorage.setItem('ananta_tour_seen','1') BEFORE clicking owner-login-submit. Mobile edit flow: tab-strategy → strategy-subtab-edit → edit-existing-{id} → /strategy/{id} → detail-test-strategy → /research?strat={id}. Preselected chip shows filled teal styling while others are outline-only (screenshot at /tmp/mob_final.png confirms).
